title: Playboy Magazine September 1994 Robin Givens David Geffen David Mamet
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal storage and handling wear; possible cover wear, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, September 1994 issue. Cover price $4.95.

Features:
- Robin Givens delivers a knockout pictorial
- Hollywood Confidential: Playboy interviews mega-mogul David Geffen
- David Mamet's first novel
- A stunner from Joyce Carol Oates
- 20Q with David Caruso
- Rockers: Stephen King, Dave Barry, Roy Blount Jr.
- Pro Football Forecast

NOTE ON THE PHOTOS: this issue is at TOP RIGHT in the group photo and in the middle of the stack.
